articles.text: Jean and Bob prepare for a shopping trip early in the morning. Jean urges Bob to get up at eight o’clock because they need to buy clothes for the children and Bob himself needs new suits. Bob complains that he stayed up late and doesn’t want to get up, but Jean insists. Later, Jean asks Bob if he isn’t dressed yet and tells him breakfast is on the table. Bob refuses to bathe because there is no hot water, and Jean reminds him they have to hurry. At the store, Jean tries on a hat, which Bob thinks looks awful and points out that she has already bought three. They decide not to buy anything else and go home.
